title: Redo Replacement Picking with Greiner MASTERBLOCK 96 Well Plate
author: Opentrons
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Specify Redo Replacement worklist
steps.instruction: Enter the worklist parameters as a CSV with columns: Number of Redo, pos TB_RCK_1, pos MTP_1, disposal_vol, transfer_vol, TUBE BAR, PLATE BAR. Example rows: 1,1,200,200; 2,35,200,200; 3,2,150,200; 4,90,100,100; 5,84; 6,62; 7,42; 8,18.

steps.title: Download and unzip protocol file
steps.instruction: Download your protocol file and unzip it if necessary.

steps.title: Upload custom labware to OT App
steps.instruction: In the OT App, navigate to More → Custom Labware → Add Labware and select your labware JSON files.

steps.title: Upload protocol file to OT App
steps.instruction: In the OT App Protocol tab, upload the protocol file with a .py extension.

steps.title: Set up deck according to map
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck hardware exactly as shown in the provided deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware, tiprack, and pipette
steps.instruction: Use the OT App to calibrate all labware, tiprack, and the pipette; follow the support article for calibration tips.

steps.title: Run the protocol
steps.instruction: Press the Run button in the OT App to start the Redo Replacement Picking protocol.
